subject.title: fix(sqlite): allow verified shared wal backports

question: Should OpenClaw support a shared-system SQLite backport exception, and if so what auditable verification contract is sufficient before WAL safety may be bypassed?
rationale: Source can establish that the proposed variable bypasses the guard, but it cannot determine whether a self-attested distribution backport is an acceptable permanent safety and support contract.

options.title: Keep the fail-closed guard
options.body: Reject the PR’s unconditional environment override and require a known-safe upstream SQLite version until a verifiable backport mechanism exists.

options.title: Define a supported backport contract
options.body: Specify a narrow, documented, testable attestation or distribution-verification path before permitting a shared-library exception.

recommendation.title: Keep the fail-closed guard
recommendation.body: Reject the PR’s unconditional environment override and require a known-safe upstream SQLite version until a verifiable backport mechanism exists.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the adjacent SQLite safety diagnostic and version-contract surface.
